name: Lantern Lane
description: Build and revise a finite-fleet delivery network as lantern workshops open and queues grow.
natural_language: Connect matching lantern homes and workshops. Each cart travels there and back. Expand the roads when workshops open, and deliver every displayed order before any queue exceeds its limit. Operate only the visible task webpage using screenshots and visible controls. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, blank, settings, or pre-existing tabs. Task-created tabs are allowed only through their visible task controls.

metadata.notes: Original graph transport simulation. Script evidence does not establish human usability or agent difficulty. Baseline L4 is provisional.
